newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber to offer service in Oklahoma.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber to offer service in Oklahoma.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Wednesday the Oklahoma Corporation Commission approved its interconnection agreement with Southwestern Bell, a unit of SBC Communications Inc.

The pact will allow Brooks Fiber to offer a full range of local telephone exchange services to business and residential customers in the Tulsa and Oklahama City metropolitan areas, the company said. The agreement is the first allowing local competition in Oklahoma, Brooks Fiber said.
Brooks Fiber provides local communications services in medium-sized cities nationwide.
